metaTitle: Custom Medium Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom medium lanyards and badge holders for your team. Durable, comfortable, and perfect for daily wear. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Medium lanyards offer a balanced width that provides durability without being bulky, making them ideal for everyday badge access in offices, warehouses, and events. At 5/8 to 3/4 inch wide, they comfortably hold ID badges, keys, or USB drives while minimizing neck strain. Options like the 3/4" Woven Lanyard or Antimicrobial Lanyard give you flexibility in material and safety features. Perfect for screen printing or woven logos, medium lanyards ensure your brand is visible without overwhelming the wearer.
heroAltText: Assorted custom medium lanyards with badge holders and printed logos, displayed on a neutral background.
